ingredients.name: duck breast
ingredients.preparation: skin scored in a crosshatch, not through the meat

steps.title: Score and season
steps.body: Score the duck skin. Salt the duck with 1 1/4 tsp salt and the pepper. Halve the cherries if they are large, and mince the shallot. Save the last 1/4 tsp salt for the arugula. About 10 minutes.

steps.title: Sear the skin
steps.body: Put the breasts skin-side down in a cold skillet. Set the heat to medium. Sear until the skin is crisp and golden and the fat has rendered, about 10 minutes, pouring off fat as it collects and saving 1 tbsp. Flip and sear the flesh side about 7 minutes, to 165 F. Rest the duck on a plate for 5 minutes. Optional traditional preparation: a rosy interior, about 135 F, after about 3 minutes on the flesh side. That lower temperature does not meet the USDA/FDA recommendation and carries higher risk, especially for young children, pregnant people, older adults, and anyone immunocompromised.

steps.title: Cherry sauce and arugula
steps.body: Pour off all but 1 tsp of fat. Cook the shallot 30 seconds. Add the cherries, vinegar, wine, honey, and thyme. Simmer until the sauce coats a spoon, about 6 minutes, while the duck rests. Slice the duck. Toss the arugula with the reserved 1 tbsp of rendered fat and the last 1/4 tsp salt. Cook is 26 minutes.
